sentences.en: An original written with simplicity and clarity makes translators happy.
sentences.zh: 一篇用简单明了的语言撰写的原稿会让译者感到开心。

sentences.en: I was astonished by the clarity of the picture.
sentences.zh: 我对那幅画的清晰度感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Keep your cool and answer with clarity and precision.
sentences.zh: 保持冷静，回答时要清晰准确。

senses.zh: 清晰度，明晰；清楚，明确；透明度
